falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the S&P 500 closes at least 5% above its lowest close of the prior 20 sessions and the VIX closes below 15 for three consecutive sessions.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The Aug-2024-style bottom analog resolved into a confirmed risk-on rally, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was too indecisive and a bullish call was required.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the S&P 500 closes more than 4% below its lowest close of the prior 20 sessions on the same day ICE BofA US High Yield OAS (or CDX HY) widens by at least 50 basis points from its level at the start of the window.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Price and credit broke the bottom_2024_aug template; the 77% pattern match and HOLD were wrong and the phase is a breakdown, not an unresolved bottom.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days either the blowoff score prints at or above 70, or a scheduled CPI release or FOMC decision produces a single-session S&P 500 move of at least 3% with the VIX closing above 30.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The regime left the moderate, non-blowoff unknown state (score 39, phase Unknown); HOLD failed because a decisive directional or stress regime was already identifiable.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
